suite.title: Nomi Android Calorie Tracker - Difficult Nutrition Evals

semantics.toleranceRule: For standard numeric comparisons, allowed deviation is max(absolute, abs(expected) * relativePercent / 100). comparisonOverrides take precedence.
semantics.allZeroRule: All-zero results are valid only when expected.outcome is no_result, needs_clarification, reject_unverified, or when tagged legitimate_all_zero.
semantics.citationRule: verified_real cases require a supporting source from sourceRefs. A URL alone is insufficient: it must resolve and support the exact product, market, basis, and values.
semantics.roundingRule: Expected values are rounded to 2 decimals only after all scaling. Directly printed serving rows are preferred over recomputing them from rounded per-100 values.
semantics.syntheticRule: synthetic_deterministic cases are invented QA fixtures. Their values are authoritative only inside the prompt and must never be represented as real products or external facts.
